en: Ribbon-chan... Come on, Ribbon-chan!
What's wrong with her!?
She's not moving! That attack earlier{SAUT}must have done something to her...
Oracle, can you see if there's anything{SAUT}you can do!?
Yeah, I'll take a look!
Let's see... This is the back cover, and{SAUT}that's the touch sensor...{PAGE}...Ooh, is this it!?
Sh-She's back!
Looks like the shock from that attack{SAUT}activated her sleep mode.
REBOOT COMPLETE... INITIATING{SAUT}DIAGNOSTIC SCAN...
MOBILITY, THOUGHT PROCESSING...{SAUT}ALL GREEN. SYSTEM NORMAL.
Oh, good! I'm glad you're alright,{SAUT}Ribbon-chan!
Mmhm, I'm so relieved... Really...
-SAN, YOU ARE CRYING.{SAUT}ARE YOU SAD?
Huh?
ACCORDING TO MY DATA, HUMANS{SAUT}SHED A SUBSTANCE CALLED TEARS{SAUT}WHEN THEY ARE SAD.{PAGE}THUS, YOU ARE SAD, CORRECT?
That's complicated. People cry when{SAUT}they're sad, but sometimes when{SAUT}they're happy, too.
When my dinner tastes delicious, or{SAUT}when I'm having fun with everyone,{SAUT}that makes me want to cry, too.
True, we also cry when we feel relieved{SAUT}or especially moved.
YOU CAN BE MOVED TO TEARS BY{SAUT}BEING HAPPY? OR SAD? OR RELIEVED?
I guess you could say there are many{SAUT}different emotions that can evoke such{SAUT}a reaction when felt intensely enough.
SO IT CAN BE DIFFERENT EMOTIONS...{SAUT}PERHAPS THAT IS WHAT HAPPENED{SAUT}TO ME EARLIER?
To what are you referring?

THE OVERSEER CALLED ME AN ERROR.{SAUT}THIS IS A FACT―I AM, BY DEFINITION,{SAUT}ERRONEOUS―BUT, DESPITE THIS...{PAGE}HIS STATEMENT ONLY MADE MY{SAUT}THOUGHTS MORE COMPLEX AND MY{SAUT}CHEST GROW HOT. WHAT WAS THAT?
It was rage.{OPTION}It was frustration.{OPTION}It was your rebel heart.
...Right. It's only natural to get pissed off{SAUT}if someone tries to deny your existence{SAUT}as an individual.
I get that...{PAGE}Someone else decidin' all on their own{SAUT}what you're supposed to be? That totally{SAUT}pisses me off too.
Yeah. He denied the validity of your{SAUT}existence, Ribbon. Of course that{SAUT}worked you up enough to defy him.
I SEE... EMOTIONS ARE COMPLEX AND{SAUT}DIFFICULT TO FULLY UNDERSTAND.
Well, that's because you've got to{SAUT}experience 'em more to be able{SAUT}to figure 'em out.
But, I'm sure you'll work it out for{SAUT}yourself, Ribbon-chan.
YES. I WISH TO COMPREHEND.
Attention, all units on patrol!
Wha―The Overseer!?

Dangerous abnormalities are currently{SAUT}wreaking havoc within the facility.{SAUT}Increase security measures immediately.{PAGE}These errors are to be handled in an{SAUT}appropriate manner upon sight.{SAUT}Irregularity must be error-radicated!
What the hell!? I thought we beat him{SAUT}already!{PAGE}Wait... Don't tell me even that guy's{SAUT}mass-produced!
It's possible that a Mother Computer{SAUT}is behind all of this activity.
A Mother Computer?

The master control unit that commands{SAUT}this world. They're fairly standard in{SAUT}sci-fi movies with robotic societies.{PAGE}That would mean the Overseer we{SAUT}defeated was only a portion of said{SAUT}computer.
In other words, until we destroy the{SAUT}root cause, this world can't be righted.
Yeah. The way things are going, Ribbon{SAUT}and the other robots are just gonna{SAUT}stay oppressed...
Then there's only one thing{SAUT}for us to do now...{PAGE}Find the Mother Computer and shut{SAUT}it down. Does that sound like a plan?
I was going to say that.{OPTION}Let's put an end to this.
We're all on the same wavelength here.{SAUT}There's no need to fuss over it!
Right, let's take our fists to the source.{SAUT}No need to hold back.
LET'S DO THIS!
Woah! Gettin' fired up too, huh,{SAUT}Ribbon-chan?
YES. MY CHEST FEELS HOT AGAIN.
Heh! But, you don't have any battle{SAUT}functions, right? Just leave the Mother{SAUT}Computer to us.
REGARDING THAT―ORACLE, IF I MAY{SAUT}SPEAK WITH YOU FOR A MOMENT...
What up?
Wh-Whaaa―!?
YES. I DISCOVERED IT DURING A SELF-{SAUT}DIAGNOSTIC SCAN... WHAT DO YOU{SAUT}THINK?
I mean, I can hammer out a quick{SAUT}program rewrite for you, but... Do{SAUT}you really wanna do this, Ribbon?
YES. I'M ASKING THIS OF MY OWN{SAUT}WILL.
Alright, Ribbon...
Excuse me, you two―we need to get{SAUT}moving.
Ah―H-Hold on a sec!{PAGE}I wanna do a quick once-over of{SAUT}Ribbon's programming, just to make{SAUT}sure she didn't sustain any real damage.
Well then, what say we wait until those{SAUT}two are ready?
Sorry, I'll make it super-fast. Just gimme{SAUT}a sec!
ORACLE... I ENTRUST MYSELF TO YOU.
You know, we obtained a key card from{SAUT}the Overseer―where do you suppose{SAUT}it's used?
We came across a locked door earlier.{SAUT}Maybe we can use it there?
That's quite possible. If we can unlock{SAUT}that door, we may be able to proceed{SAUT}onward.
I don't know, but we should probably{SAUT}look for a place where we can try it.
You're right. That could very well{SAUT}open up a new path for us.
And there... we... go!
Sorry for the wait, folks. We can scoot{SAUT}whenever now!
